_source: ADR-0009. Limits for linkedin.py check; numbers marked heuristic are rules of thumb, not LinkedIn limits.
author: Kamil Jan

text._hashtags: round 2 SYNTH2-linkedin R1: 6/6 creators median 0 hashtags; 3 = the fail limit in video-pipeline style/platform_limits.json
text._hook_max: heuristic: the first line has to stand alone in the feed
text._fold_max: heuristic: roughly what shows before '...więcej' on desktop; the first two lines must fit
text._comment_max: LinkedIn comment limit as of 2026-11 (not checked against an official page)
text._min_chars: heuristic: below this a document post reads as a bare upload

image._source: 2026-11-15: image post (text + grafika.png). Hook/fold/link are heuristics: for image and video posts they are warnings in the dry run, Kamil decides
image._alt_max: Images API altText limit (docs 2026-11; recommended under 120)
image._max_pixels: Images API: fewer than 36,152,320 pixels; JPG, GIF, PNG

video._source: 2026-11-15: video post (a short). Videos API limits from the docs, 2026-11
video._bytes: Videos API: 75 KB to 500 MB, MP4, 3 s to 30 min
